notes.title: Dark Gate 2025
notes.content:
🚀 Dark Gate 2025 – New Universe Launch!
Ready for a new adventure?
On Friday, April 4th 2025 at 7:00 PM (CEST), a new round begins in the Dark Gate universe!

⚙️ Universe Settings:
  Universe Speed: 4x  Flight Speed: 3x  Planets: 9 (+1 purchasable)  Astros: Max. 2  Scanner: 1 (with Fleeter Spec 2)

🌟 Features:
  Tunnel system & burrowable defenses  ISB explosion  New AZ system: Attack from 25% to 400% of your points  Speedup system for a faster start (up to 500 billion Spice!)

🔁 Account Transfer After Event:
After the event, you can transfer your account to RETRO, Nexus, or Sirius – or secure Spice for your main account!  Resources will be reduced by 80% during full transfer  Alternative: Transfer 20% of Spice value (limit: 100–200 billion)

📅 Event Duration:
  Start: Friday, April 4th 2025 – 7:00 PM (CEST)  End: Sunday, August 17th 2025 – 10:00 PM (CEST)

🌌 See you in Dark Gate!
– Your SpaceInvasion Team
